units.source_text: 自己费了好大劲儿，好容易才找到目的地的沙滩，所以，眼下只好将就将就。

en.t: After going to so much trouble and finally finding the beach he had been aiming for, for now he had no choice but to make do.

units.source_text: 男人含了一口水壶里的水，然后，又饱饱地吸了一口风，

en.t: The man took a mouthful of water from his canteen, then drew in another deep breath of the wind,

units.source_text: 那风看起来清明澄碧，可吸进嘴里却沙沙的。

en.t: which looked clear and blue, but felt gritty with sand when he breathed it into his mouth.
